presentation.label: KIT PER BANK
presentation.summary: One kit per bank, like the Octatrack's parts, with per-pattern locks: the 16 patterns of a bank share one sound, and [PTN]+[YES] gives a pattern its own.
presentation.overview: With KIT PER BANK ticked in SETTINGS, the 16 patterns of a bank share one kit, the kit of the bank's first pattern: A01 to A16 play A01's kit, B01 to B16 play B01's kit, and so on. Change pattern inside a bank and the sound stays; a sound edit on any pattern of the bank is heard on all of them. Hold PTN and press YES to LOCK the active pattern: it takes a copy of the bank's sound and keeps its own from then on; PTN+YES again shares the bank's kit again. A pasted pattern whose sound differs from its bank's becomes locked with that sound, so a paste never overwrites the bank. The switch and the locks are saved with the project; a project without them, and every existing project, opens with the switch off and plays as on the stock OS.
highlights: Octatrack-style shared kits: change pattern inside a bank, keep the sound.
PTN+YES locks a pattern to its own copy of the sound; PTN+YES again shares the bank's kit.
Saved per project; existing projects open unchanged with KIT PER BANK off.
Nothing is rewritten: unticked, every pattern plays its own kit again, and the project still opens on the stock OS.
usage: Open SETTINGS, scroll to the bottom and tick KIT PER BANK, then select A01 again.
Set up a bass sound on A01, then go to A02 and program different notes: same sound. Turn the filter on A02; A01 changes too.
Go to A03, hold PTN and press YES: KIT LOCKED. Change the sound of A03; A01 and A02 keep theirs.
Save the project: KIT PER BANK and the lock are saved with it. Hold PTN and press YES on A03 again to share the bank's kit.

access.location: SETTINGS, last row: KIT PER BANK; lock: hold PTN, press YES
steps: Press SETTINGS and scroll to the last row, KIT PER BANK; press YES to tick it (YES again unticks it).
Change pattern, or select the current pattern again: the setting applies from that pattern change.
To give the active pattern its own sound, hold PTN and press YES: KIT LOCKED. Hold PTN and press YES again: KIT SHARED.

controls.name: KIT PER BANK
controls.doc: SETTINGS, last row. Ticked: the patterns of each bank share the kit of the bank's first pattern, except locked patterns. Unticked: every pattern plays its own kit, as on the stock OS. Saved with the project (off for a project saved without it); a change applies from the next pattern change.

controls.name: PTN+YES
controls.doc: While KIT PER BANK is ticked: locks the active pattern (it takes a copy of the bank's kit and keeps its own sound; message KIT LOCKED) or shares it again (KIT SHARED). On a bank's first pattern it only shows BANK KIT. Locks are saved with the project. Unticked, PTN+YES does what the stock OS does (nothing).

limitations: Built for Digitone OS 1.44 with the vendored core-dn1 2.0a (os1.44); not ported to OS 1.43. The Digitone Keys runs the same OS file but has not been tried.

The switch and the locks are kept in the project header (an elekloader-format ELKP block tagged KBLK, bytes 0x1c..0x200 the stock OS keeps as they are), written by kitbank's own project save hook because core-dn1 2.0a for 1.44 has no project data. The block is not written when that area already holds another tool's data; it can move to core_projdata when a 1.44 core provides it.

It patches ten stock OS sites itself (kit selection, queued pattern change, kit save/reload/sound reload, project save/load/new); a mod patching the same bytes cannot be combined. If other mods need kit selection or project data, these sites should become core hooks.

A pattern pasted into a bank's first pattern replaces the bank's kit, as the stock OS replaces that pattern's kit. Pasted elsewhere, it never overwrites the bank: it is locked with the pasted sound when that sound differs.
For under a second after PTN+YES, a knob turn can be ignored while the OS reloads the kit into the tracks (measured in the emulator; the stock OS reselecting a pattern by hand does not do this).
Undo of a paste was not tried.

load.conditions: No audio-rate code: the redirections run on pattern changes, screen and edit kit lookups, the pattern menus' kit save and reload, project save and load, pastes and the PTN+YES key.

tests.summary: Emulator only (digiemu, OS 1.44): unticked behaves like the stock OS; ticked, bank kits for immediate and queued changes, song mode, edits, kit save/reload, PTN+YES locks, pastes, and the switch and locks through a project save and load; see TESTING.md. Not tried on hardware in this Modwerk build.
